'''Sarmuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he asked a Republic citizen to destroy a Imperial ion disruptor.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Sarmuk appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Ilum and begins the mission "Crystal Clear Sabotage".
